channels.name: poke-center
channels.topic: The Pokémon Centre, east side of the square. Healing, the PC, and the first bed most trainers sleep in away from home.  → #sakura-square

channels.name: sakura-lab
channels.topic: The Professor's lab on the square's north side: starters, the regional dex, and a garden out back that is mostly Oddish.  → #sakura-square

channels.name: sakura-square
channels.topic: The middle of town: a paved square with the old well at its centre, benches, and a noticeboard nobody has cleared since spring. Everything in Sakura is a minute from here.  → #the-old-well, #sakura-lab, #poke-center, #sakura-mart, #shrine-steps, #blossom-road, #sakura-houses

channels.name: shrine-steps
channels.topic: Stone steps climbing the blossom slope behind the town to a small shrine. Best view of the bay, and the quietest place to think.  → #sakura-square

channels.name: sakura-mart
channels.topic: The Mart, west side. Balls, potions and the Candy Shop counter at the back. List prices here - anywhere else the Rotom Drone charges to deliver.  → #sakura-square

channels.name: blossom-road
channels.topic: The road out of town, north past the last houses, where the blossom ends and Route 1 begins.  → #sakura-square, Route 1

channels.name: the-old-well
channels.topic: The well in the middle of the square. Sweet water, a bucket on a rope, and a coin tradition nobody can explain any more.  → #sakura-square

channels.name: sakura-houses
channels.topic: The lanes of houses below the square, washing lines and low walls, sloping down towards the sand.  → #sakura-square, #sakura-beach

channels.name: sakura-beach
channels.topic: The town beach at the bottom of the lanes: grey sand, a boat pulled up past the tideline, and the bay going quiet in the evening. Shellder and Wingull, and the water is calm enough to swim.  → #sakura-houses, #cynthias-house

channels.name: cynthias-house
channels.topic: The house at the far end of the beach: driftwood porch, a garden of sea grass, and the shutters open whether or not anyone is in. Cynthia keeps it.  → #sakura-beach

channels.name: train-station
channels.topic: The station hall and the island hub: departure boards, the rail south to Sakura, and roads east and north from the doors.  → #ticket-hall, #platform-two, #station-market, #freight-yard, #lost-property, Route 1, Route 2, Route 4

channels.name: platform-two
channels.topic: The southbound platform, open to the weather. The Sakura train leaves from here.  → #train-station, Sakura Town

channels.name: ticket-hall
channels.topic: Ticket windows, a tea stall and the queue. Where you find out the next train is in forty minutes.  → #train-station

channels.name: station-market
channels.topic: Stalls along the station wall: hot food, second-hand gear, and trainers trading in the gaps between trains.  → #train-station

channels.name: freight-yard
channels.topic: Containers, a crane and a gate that is meant to be locked. Paperwork here does not always match what is in the boxes.  → #train-station

channels.name: lost-property
channels.topic: A counter behind the ticket hall, shelves of umbrellas and one very patient clerk.  → #train-station

channels.name: the-fields
channels.topic: Barley, hedgerows and ploughed rows: the open farmland that is the middle of Amber Fields. Paths run off it in every direction.  → #glasshouse-gym, #farm-shop, #mill-pond, #the-barns, #scarecrow-lane, Route 2, Route 3, Route 5

channels.name: glasshouse-gym
channels.topic: The Grass gym: a working glasshouse, warm and wet, where the leader is whoever is winning the harvest this year.  → #the-fields

channels.name: farm-shop
channels.topic: A farm shop by the lane - eggs, berries, cold drinks. Not a Poké Mart, so the drone still charges to bring your shopping.  → #the-fields

channels.name: mill-pond
channels.topic: The pond beside the old mill, still and green at the edges. Water Pokémon, and a jetty to fish from.  → #the-fields, #the-jetty

channels.name: the-barns
channels.topic: Hay, cats, machinery and shade. Trainers sleep here when the inn is full and the farmer pretends not to notice.  → #the-fields

channels.name: scarecrow-lane
channels.topic: A sunken lane of scarecrows, each dressed by a different family. The oldest is a hundred years old and nobody will say which.  → #the-fields

channels.name: docks
channels.topic: The working waterfront: cranes, nets, crates and shouting. Everything in Minato leads back here.  → #ferry-terminal, #fish-market, #harbour-mart, #harbour-gym, #poke-center-minato, #the-breakwater, #warehouse-row, #harbour-inn, Route 3

channels.name: ferry-terminal
channels.topic: The ferry building. Timetables, a waiting room and the boats that leave the island.  → #docks

channels.name: fish-market
channels.topic: Early, loud, and over by nine. Ice, crates and the best food on the island if you know which stall.  → #docks

channels.name: harbour-mart
channels.topic: The Poké Mart on the quay, chandlery on one side, balls and medicine on the other. List prices here.  → #docks

channels.name: harbour-gym
channels.topic: The Water gym, built into the sea wall itself: the floor floods to the tide and the leader knows the timetable.  → #docks

channels.name: poke-center-minato
channels.topic: The Pokémon Centre above the harbour, windows on the water.  → #docks

channels.name: the-breakwater
channels.topic: The long arm of stone out into the bay. Waves one side, boats the other, and fishing at the end of it.  → #docks

channels.name: warehouse-row
channels.topic: Sheds along the back of the quay. One of them is rented by people nobody at the harbour office can describe.  → #docks

channels.name: harbour-inn
channels.topic: Beds, a fire and a bar that argues about football. The cheapest room on the coast.  → #docks

channels.name: victory-gatehouse
channels.topic: The gate at the foot of the mountain: eight badges checked, water sold, and the only place to turn back without losing face.  → #the-lower-slopes, Route 10

channels.name: the-lower-slopes
channels.topic: Open switchbacks above the gate, gorse and scree, the League already in sight far above.  → #victory-gatehouse, #first-cave

channels.name: first-cave
channels.topic: The first cave: short, wet, and it puts you back outside a hundred metres higher.  → #the-lower-slopes, #the-cliff-path

channels.name: the-cliff-path
channels.topic: A ledge with a drop on one side and a handrail that stops halfway along.  → #first-cave, #rope-bridges

channels.name: rope-bridges
channels.topic: Three spans over the gorges, crossed one person at a time, in the wind.  → #the-cliff-path, #second-cave

channels.name: second-cave
channels.topic: The long cave. Dark, branching, and the way through is not the way that feels right.  → #rope-bridges, #final-climb

channels.name: final-climb
channels.topic: Stairs cut into the last of the rock, straight up to the plateau and the League doors.  → #second-cave, Kagura League

channels.name: league-lobby
channels.topic: The top of Victory Road: badge check, a desk, and four doors in a row. Nobody goes through without eight badges.  → #league-centre, #league-mart, #hall-the-first, Victory Road

channels.name: league-centre
channels.topic: The last Pokémon Centre. Heal here; there is no healing past the first door.  → #league-lobby

channels.name: league-mart
channels.topic: The last Mart, priced for people who are about to need everything.  → #league-lobby

channels.name: hall-the-first
channels.topic: The first hall of the Elite Four. The door behind you closes when you enter.  → #hall-the-second

channels.name: hall-the-second
channels.topic: The second hall. No way back, and the floor plan tells you nothing about who is waiting.  → #hall-the-third

channels.name: hall-the-third
channels.topic: The third hall, colder than the others, and the light comes from below.  → #hall-the-fourth

channels.name: hall-the-fourth
channels.topic: The fourth hall, and the longest walk of the four.  → #champions-chamber

channels.name: champions-chamber
channels.topic: The Champion waits here, and the room is built so you can hear yourself breathe.  → #hall-of-fame

channels.name: hall-of-fame
channels.topic: Where a winning team is recorded, permanently, with the trainer who brought it.  → #league-lobby

channels.name: hinomiya-shrine
channels.topic: The fire shrine on the caldera rim. Kagura is danced here, and the region took its name from it.  → #the-shrine-stair, #the-rim-platform

channels.name: midori-jungle
channels.topic: Hot, close jungle under a closed canopy: vines, standing water, and things moving above you.  → #the-green-side, #the-rain-shadow, Route 13

channels.name: kuroihama
channels.topic: Black volcanic sand, hot underfoot by afternoon, steam where the streams reach the sea.  → #the-black-sand, Route 11

channels.name: the-crater-pool
channels.topic: A hot pool in an old crater, turquoise and dangerous to swim in. Fire and Water both live here.  → Route 11

channels.name: ashen-onsen
channels.topic: A hot-spring inn on the volcanic slope: tatami, screens, and steam coming through the floor.  → #the-outdoor-bath, #the-guest-rooms, Route 11

channels.name: storm-observatory
channels.topic: A weather station on the high ridge: instruments, aerials, and the best view of anything coming.  → #the-weather-logs, Route 9

channels.name: the-ashfields
channels.topic: Ash plains south of the caldera, grey to the horizon, with green coming back in patches.  → #warm-ground, Route 11

channels.name: sulphur-barrens
channels.topic: Yellow crust, bad air and nothing growing. Wear the mask they sell in Ember.  → #the-vents-north, Route 12

channels.name: long-sands
channels.topic: Miles of pale beach with nothing built on it. Good for walking, better for catching.  → #the-shallows-south, Route 5

channels.name: the-mill-pond
channels.topic: The pond behind the mill, weed-green at the edges and deeper than it looks.  → #the-jetty, Amber Fields

channels.name: kagura-reservoir
channels.topic: The island's water: a wide reservoir behind a concrete dam, fenced but not well.  → #the-dam-wall, Route 8

channels.name: the-stables
channels.topic: Long timber stalls and a yard of raked sand. Rideable Pokémon are kept, trained and hired out from here.  → #the-paddocks, #tack-room, Route 6

channels.name: the-day-care
channels.topic: The Day Care house: leave a Pokémon and it comes back stronger. `!daycare` on the bot does the paperwork.  → #the-walled-garden, Route 6

channels.name: hares-meadow
channels.topic: Rough meadow of long grass and thistle, more alive at dusk than at noon.  → #the-long-grass, Route 2

channels.name: the-windbreaks
channels.topic: Planted lines of trees holding the wind off the fields. Shelter on one side, gale on the other.  → #hedgerow-walk, Route 4

channels.name: saltmarsh-flats
channels.topic: Salt marsh cut by creeks, half land and half sea depending on the hour.  → #the-creeks, Route 5

channels.name: shell-strand
channels.topic: A beach made of shells rather than sand, loud to walk on and impossible to sneak along.  → #the-shell-line, Route 14

channels.name: moon-pool
channels.topic: A pool that only fills on the high tides. Bright water, pale stone, and it is worth coming at night.  → #the-night-water, Route 14

channels.name: trainers-hall
channels.topic: A hall built for battling: rings, benches, a board of challenges and someone always up for one.  → #the-open-ladder, #the-wall-of-names, Route 12

channels.name: driftwood-cove
channels.topic: A cove of bleached driftwood stacked by storms into shapes people keep adding to.  → #the-tideline, Route 12

channels.name: the-palmlands
channels.topic: Palm scrub behind the dunes, shade and sand together, warm all year.  → #the-green-middle, Route 13

channels.name: windward-dunes
channels.topic: High dunes on the weather side, marram grass, and a ridge that moves every winter.  → #the-dune-line, Route 14

channels.name: the-reef
channels.topic: Living coral in clear shallow water, the whole lagoon floor visible from a boat.  → #tide-pools, #the-shallows, #drop-off, Route 14

channels.name: mirror-tarn
channels.topic: A still mountain lake that takes the sky exactly. Cold, deep, and worth the walk.  → #the-shingle-shore, Route 9

channels.name: the-old-mine
channels.topic: The mine mouth and the yard outside it: rails, a tipped truck, and a gate that has been open for years.  → #upper-galleries, #the-water-line, Route 7

channels.name: the-pinewood
channels.topic: Planted pine, needle floor, and quiet of the kind that makes people talk quietly.  → #planting-rows, Route 7

channels.name: kogarashi-heath
channels.topic: Open heather and wind with nothing to stop it. The north island in one word.  → #the-tors, Route 8

channels.name: the-standing-stones
channels.topic: A ring of nine stones on open heath, eight standing. People feel watched here and are not entirely wrong.  → #stones-gym, #the-fallen-ninth, Route 8

channels.name: stones-gym
channels.topic: The Psychic gym, underground beneath the ring: a stair between two stones, and a chamber lit by what the leader is doing.  → #the-standing-stones

channels.name: the-fallen-ninth
channels.topic: The ninth stone, down and half buried. The carvings on the underside are the only ones nobody has copied.  → #the-standing-stones

channels.name: watari-bridge
channels.topic: The old bridge between islands: timber, stone piers, and a plank that everybody knows about.  → #the-toll-house, #under-the-span, Route 6, Route 7

channels.name: kakehashi-bridge
channels.topic: The new bridge: steel, long, and singing in a crosswind.  → #the-north-tower, #the-south-tower, Route 12, Route 13

channels.name: beacon-rock
channels.topic: A rock island with a lighthouse on it, reached by boat or by wading at the lowest tides.  → #the-light, #keepers-room, Route 13

channels.name: sunken-bell
channels.topic: A temple bell on the seabed, upright, too big to have been dropped by accident.  → #the-bell-chamber

channels.name: the-treeline
channels.topic: The edge of the wood, where the light stops. Everyone starts here and most people stop here.  → #deep-woods, Route 7

channels.name: deep-woods
channels.topic: Close trunks, no birds, and the path underfoot is not always the one you were on.  → #the-treeline, #lantern-clearing, #where-the-paths-move

channels.name: lantern-clearing
channels.topic: A clearing hung with paper lanterns that are lit every evening by nobody anyone has met.  → #deep-woods, #woods-gym, #the-shrine-ruin

channels.name: woods-gym
channels.topic: The Ghost gym off the lantern clearing: a house that is the wrong size inside.  → #lantern-clearing

channels.name: the-shrine-ruin
channels.topic: A collapsed shrine, its offerings fresh. Somebody keeps up a place that has no roof.  → #lantern-clearing

channels.name: where-the-paths-move
channels.topic: The part of the wood that does not hold still. Go in with a plan; you will leave by a different way.  → #deep-woods

channels.name: castle-gate
channels.topic: The gate of a castle that should not be here: open, unguarded, and swept.  → #throne-room, #library, #undercroft, #the-battlements, Route 8

channels.name: throne-room
channels.topic: A long hall with one chair at the end of it, and dust that avoids the chair.  → #castle-gate, #kings-quarters

channels.name: library
channels.topic: Shelves to the ceiling. The books are about Pokémon, and the margins argue with the text.  → #castle-gate

channels.name: undercroft
channels.topic: Cellars below the hall, cold, and larger than the castle above them.  → #castle-gate

channels.name: the-battlements
channels.topic: The wall walk, with the whole heath below and the weather coming from the north.  → #castle-gate

channels.name: kings-quarters
channels.topic: Private rooms behind the throne, lived in recently by somebody tidy.  → #throne-room

channels.name: foothills
channels.topic: The approach: scree, thin air, and the last grass on the mountain.  → #climbers-hut, #silver-cave, Route 10

channels.name: peak
channels.topic: The summit. Nothing up here but weather, and whoever else was mad enough.  → #the-ice-shelf

channels.name: silver-cave
channels.topic: The cave through the mountain's heart. Cold, unlit, and the strongest things on the island live in it.  → #foothills, #the-ice-shelf

channels.name: the-ice-shelf
channels.topic: A shelf of old ice above the cave, wind-scoured and blue where it breaks.  → #silver-cave, #peak

channels.name: climbers-hut
channels.topic: A stone hut with a stove and a visitors' book. Sign it; people check.  → #foothills

channels.name: caldera-town
channels.topic: The town inside the old caldera: black stone streets, steam from the gratings, and the rim standing over everything.  → #ember-gym, #poke-center-ember, #ember-mart, #hot-springs, #ash-flats, #the-vents, #obsidian-works, Route 11

channels.name: ash-flats
channels.topic: The grey plain outside the town where ash settles deep enough to walk in. Things live in it.  → #caldera-town, #warm-ground

channels.name: ember-gym
channels.topic: The Fire gym, cut into the caldera wall. Hot enough that the queue waits outside.  → #caldera-town

channels.name: poke-center-ember
channels.topic: The Pokémon Centre, cool inside for once, with the shutters down against the ash.  → #caldera-town

channels.name: ember-mart
channels.topic: The Mart on the main street. List prices, and a shelf of dust masks nobody buys until the first fall.  → #caldera-town

channels.name: hot-springs
channels.topic: Public baths fed straight from the ground: three pools, hottest at the top, and a rule about washing first that everybody follows.  → #caldera-town

channels.name: the-vents
channels.topic: Fissures on the slope, sulphur and heat haze, roped off in the places that have killed someone.  → #caldera-town

channels.name: obsidian-works
channels.topic: A glassworks running on volcanic heat. The night shift is larger than the work needs.  → #caldera-town

channels.name: storm-watch
channels.topic: The cliff-top village on the shelf, roofs weighted with stone against the wind.  → #shelf-gym, #cliff-stairs, #the-pylons, Route 9

channels.name: shelf-gym
channels.topic: The Electric gym on the cliff edge, wired into the pylons and loudest during a storm.  → #storm-watch

channels.name: cliff-stairs
channels.topic: Cut steps down the cliff face to the water, wet the whole way.  → #storm-watch

channels.name: the-pylons
channels.topic: The line of pylons marching inland. They hum, and in the right weather they sing.  → #storm-watch

channels.name: cinder-row
channels.topic: A single row of houses on the black shore, built for the works and outlasting it.  → #row-shop, #the-jetty, Route 12

channels.name: row-shop
channels.topic: One shop for the whole row: post, groceries, fishing line, gossip. Not a Poké Mart.  → #cinder-row

channels.name: the-jetty
channels.topic: A short wooden jetty into deep cold water. The fishing is better than the village admits.  → #cinder-row

channels.name: the-stacks
channels.topic: Sea stacks standing out of the shallows, the town built along and between them on boardwalks.  → #tidecall-gym, #poke-center-tsuki, #tidecall-mart, #the-causeway, #stilt-houses, Route 13

channels.name: tidecall-gym
channels.topic: The gym on the furthest stack, reached at low tide or not at all. Time your challenge.  → #the-stacks, #the-causeway

channels.name: poke-center-tsuki
channels.topic: The Pokémon Centre on the main stack, lamp lit all night for boats.  → #the-stacks

channels.name: tidecall-mart
channels.topic: The Mart on the boardwalk, everything stocked in crates against the damp. List prices here.  → #the-stacks

channels.name: the-causeway
channels.topic: The stone path to the gym stack, underwater twice a day. The tide table is painted on the wall at both ends.  → #the-stacks, #tidecall-gym

channels.name: stilt-houses
channels.topic: Homes on piles over the water, joined by walkways, with boats tied under the floors.  → #the-stacks

channels.name: grotto-mouth
channels.topic: The sea cave entrance, wide at low tide and gone at high. Moonlight reaches the first chamber and no further.  → #deep-grotto, #the-tide-gate, Route 14

channels.name: deep-grotto
channels.topic: Deeper chambers of still water and pale stone, quiet enough to hear your own pulse.  → #grotto-mouth, #grotto-gym

channels.name: grotto-gym
channels.topic: The Dark gym in the inner chamber, lit only where the leader wants you to look.  → #deep-grotto

channels.name: the-tide-gate
channels.topic: The iron gate across the inner passage, closed by the tide twice a day whether or not you are through it.  → #grotto-mouth

channels.name: aether-dock
channels.topic: The receiving dock of the floating station. Clean, bright, and everything is labelled.  → #conservation-wing, #labs, #observation-deck

channels.name: conservation-wing
channels.topic: Enclosures for Pokémon that were found somewhere they should not have been.  → #aether-dock

channels.name: labs
channels.topic: Laboratories behind glass. Politely, you may look; you may not open anything.  → #aether-dock

channels.name: observation-deck
channels.topic: A deck over the sea, with the best view of the strait and nobody else on it.  → #aether-dock

channels.name: the-anomaly
channels.topic: A depth reading that is wrong on every chart. Dive it and there is structure below.  → #pressure-lock

channels.name: pressure-lock
channels.topic: An airlock in the seabed, powered, and cycling for anyone who knocks.  → #the-anomaly, #abyssal-base

channels.name: abyssal-base
channels.topic: Lit corridors and working machinery, on nobody's register.  → #pressure-lock, #cold-corridor, #the-hatch

channels.name: the-hatch
channels.topic: A hatch in the floor of the deepest room. It opens downwards, into more water.  → #abyssal-base

channels.name: cold-corridor
channels.topic: A corridor kept near freezing, with doors on one side only.  → #abyssal-base

channels.name: route-1
channels.topic: Coastal meadow, hedges, a plank bridge. The first road anyone walks.  [Sakura Town → Kagura Station · ZU · Easy]

channels.name: route-2
channels.topic: A cart track between hedgerows and barley, telegraph poles all the way.  [Kagura Station → Amber Fields · ZU-PU · Easy]

channels.name: route-3
channels.topic: The land drops to the sea and the track turns to cobbles.  [Amber Fields → Minato Harbour · PU · Easy]

channels.name: route-4
channels.topic: Dunes and scrub to a shingle beach with a wrecked boat on it.  [Kagura Station → the north shore · PU · Dead end]

channels.name: route-5
channels.topic: Orchard, then meadow, then dunes and a long beach.  [Amber Fields → the south beach · PU · Easy]

channels.name: route-6
channels.topic: Ordinary woodland that stops being ordinary about halfway along.  [the lowlands → Ghost Woods · NU · Getting dark]

channels.name: route-7
channels.topic: A ridge path out of the trees, standing stones, heather, towers ahead.  [Ghost Woods → N's Castle · RU · Exposed]

channels.name: route-8
channels.topic: Pine forest rising, with a cold stream and stepping stones across it.  [Ghost Woods → Mt. Silver foothills · RU · Side trail]

channels.name: route-9
channels.topic: Scree, old snow, a ledge trail with a rope line and a long way down.  [N's Castle → the high pass · OU · CLIMB]

channels.name: route-10
channels.topic: Ash flats and lava rock, crossed on a boardwalk that has seen better days.  [Cinder Row → Ember Hollow · RU · Boardwalk]

channels.name: route-11
channels.topic: Basalt terraces like stairs, with the first pylon at the top.  [Ember Hollow → Thunder Shelf · UU · CLIMB]

channels.name: route-12
channels.topic: Black sand, sea stacks, driftwood, ash drifting over everything.  [the north coast → Cinder Row · RU · Easy]

channels.name: route-13
channels.topic: Rock shelves and tide pools, part-bridged by a walkway missing sections.  [Tidecall Town → Moonlit Grotto · UU · Tidal]

channels.name: route-14
channels.topic: A headland with sea on both sides and a land bridge at its narrowest.  [Tidecall Town → the northern headland · UU · Exposed]
